name: Kozukuri Youkai H Henka ~Otome o Okasu Hyoui Gattai~
original_name: 子作り妖怪H変化～乙女を犯す憑依合体～
source:
[i]Take back the position of Boss, greatest leader of the Exorcists![/i]
[i]Force demons to possess you and impregnate your miko childhood friend![/i]

This is a story of a shadow world where humans and demons continue to war...

My name is Ashiya Yamato.
I am a genius exorcist whose job is the cleansing of demons. That's not something that can be revealed to the outside world, though, so no one knows about it.

With the spread of civilization, demons have been reduced in size, and are about as dangerous as bugs, but I have containers in which I can collect them... because I have been disgraced!

She, Asuka, dared to snatch the position of Boss, greatest leader of the exorcists, away from the one it should have belonged to - me!

No matter. I will recover what was stolen from me. The possession abilities obtained from the demons, and the demon cleansing powers of the exorcists - once combined, nothing is impossible!

That's right, with a myriad monsters under my command, I will have no trouble ravaging Asuka!

Once pregnant, her spiritual power will be reduced, and she will fall from the position of Boss!

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=44]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
[i]夺回除魔师最高领袖“总长”的位置！[/i]
[i]强迫妖怪附身，让你的巫女青梅竹马怀孕！[/i]

这是一个人类与妖怪持续交战的暗影世界的故事……

我名叫蘆屋大和。
我是负责净化妖怪的天才除魔师。这种工作不能对外公开，因此无人知晓。

随着文明发展，妖怪数量减少，危险程度也与虫子相当；但我拥有可以收集它们的容器……因为我被剥夺了地位！

那个叫飞鸟的女人，竟敢从我手中夺走本应属于我的除魔师最高领袖“总长”之位！

无妨。我会夺回被夺走的一切。妖怪带来的附身能力，与除魔师的净妖之力结合后，没有什么办不到！

没错，麾下有万千妖怪，我要蹂躏飞鸟根本不成问题！

只要她怀孕，灵力便会减弱，也将从总长的位置上跌落！

[摘自[url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=44]MangaGamer[/url]]
